svg.title: Approval chains: a manager signs off before finance does — SoftTrack web design mockup (#296)
svg.desc: A claim goes from submitted to approved or refused and a finance admin moves it; the engineering manager who tried to approve her report’s conference ticket got 403. An instance can turn on a manager’s step before finance’s, where the manager sees their reports’ claims that await them and nothing else, with a second approver above an amount and every decision kept as a row.
